newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest OTC market up on heavyweights.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest OTC market up on heavyweights.

text.p: A bull run for high-caps, including cement makers and refineries, gripped Romania's over-the-counter market on Friday, driving up prices and two unofficial indices.
"The seven refineries and four cement makers which traded today were in strong demand," said a trader on the RASDAQ, the Romanian OTC system.
The refinery and cement sectors were expected to occupy centre-stage next week, when their prices are seen drifting to new highs.
Independent market indices -- the VAB-RASDAQ and the BIG-RASDAQ -- rose by 5.4 and respectively 2.39 percent on Friday from the previous session to 2,578.4 and 1,800.07 points respectively.
Bucharest's stock exchange, which operates three times a week, was closed on Friday. On Thursday, it was also marked by a bullish mood which drove up most of its 32 stocks.
The Bourse was mostly mixed over the week. The VAB and BIG indices for the Bourse were up on the week 5.6 percent and 7.01 percent respectively.
Cement maker Casial, which was most active throughout the week, dominated the market also on Friday, trading around 763,000 shares. It closed 125 lei stronger at 1,300 under buying pressure.
On the week, the two unofficial indices, computed by VANGUARD and Bucharest Investment Group brokerage houses, showed rises of 18 percent and respectively 17.37 percent.
Total RASDAQ turnover this week rose to around 35 billion lei from some 26 billion the previous week, with the volume of traded shares up to some 17 million from 13 million.
The system, which lists 2,740 companies, traded an average 460 stocks per session.
